equity.level_reason: Diabetes percentages are reported for adults with and without disability, overall and by age group, and described, but values are only set side by side, with no disparity framing or computed contrast.

level_alternative.reason: Disability is defined only by functional-limitation questions without social-position or access framing, so it may not count as an SPD, leaving age only.

equity.equity_measurement: Disability is a binary indicator from six functional domains (a lot of difficulty or cannot do at all in at least one); referent is adults without disability.

ev.q: Regardless of disability status, the percentage of adults with diagnosed diabetes increased with age.

notes: Claims of 'more likely' and 'increased with age' rest on values with CI error bars; no test or CI-based conclusion is stated, so no test procedure is recorded. Survey weighting is not stated, so it is not recorded.
